TEXT:
Meanwhile, the game development steadily 
continues.

As for our situation a week before the cultural 
festival, we were in a tight spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I finished the script. Please go through it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Okay, I'll look at it now!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...With all the rushing of work, I don't even know 
what I'm writing about anymore...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I'll edit where you left off, so you don't have to 
worry about it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Still, talk about being good at what you like doing... 
Even if this turns into a scene of carnage, Sena 
probably won't even stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even though most of the guys are down already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
You and him are the only remaining ones alive, 
aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
When it comes to endurance, that's where I'm most 
confident! I can go on for 2, even 3 days without 
sleep!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I can't believe this guy is actually being useful at 
the very end...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey, Makabe! I found something strange again. 
Wake up and fix this!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Ah... You found a bug...? Then, I'll wake up... Prez...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Okay, okay, naptime's over...

Even through the constant turmoil, the day of the 
cultural festival arrived.

The game research club's newest RPG 
"Brotherhood" made its debut to the entire school.

That's right, we finished the day of the cultural 
festival! Or I should say, we somehow made it in 
time. Despite being at death's door, though.
A-As for how well it was received...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Th-This is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I was doubtful about finishing it, but I listened to 
what you said and worked with all my energy and 
now, it is complete! Thank you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ummm, what did I even say...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes well, something like, "Be more honest with your 
interests!"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see, thanks to that...

The finished game actually turned into a hardcore 
homo RPG at the end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Akagi-san. When did the character names become 
Akagi and Kyousuke...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, it just didn't seem right if I didn't name them 
that. Of course, I didn't modify the scripts you 
wrote.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
And the character illustrations, when did they 
become more like me and Akagi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ehehehe. I was honest with the image in my mind 
when I made them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I wonder how you even had enough time to 
redraw the CGs...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
When you wrestle with something you love, you can 
work more than twice as fast.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Through this experience, I understood it well. Like 
your 6 kilobytes-per-hour writing, it's a speed you 
can achieve because it's a subject you love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Fufu... Fufufufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What's wrong, Kuroneko? Why are you laughing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That's right... it has to be that way... The true 
pleasure of doujins...! The culmination of 
self-satisfaction...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Ignoring all the pressure and restraints, slipping 
under even the creators' noses, squeezing in all the 
rotten materials into this path of bloodshed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
As I expected, you are no ordinary person. My 
judgment was not wrong, having granted you the 
title of The Mystic Eyes...

I don't get it, but seems like Kuroneko is seeing 
Sena as a rival in a whole new level now...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
U-Umm... Can I ask something? This character 
jealous about the relationship between Akagi and 
Kyousuke and always being tortured by them...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Who else do you think resembles him?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[font_size=26]Riiiighhhht!? No matter how you look at 
this character, I'm the model, right??[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I put a considerable amount of effort into the 
scene where you get disabled, so please look 
forward to it!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[font_size=18]This game... is being released in the school's cultural festival, 
right...[/font_size][font_size=15]Right...?[/font_size]

Forget the game, the real Makabe looks like he's 
disabled already...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It was... pretty well-received.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I-Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
The people who played it had fun. The anime club 
members even praised us, going "This looks pretty 
professional."

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I'm just glad that more people came. Until now, not 
many people even came to look at our works.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
I got some people from the soccer club to come 
too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, it didn't really matter if they were here 
anyway...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Hey, rejoice everyone! I bring some good news.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Ah, President. Where have you been?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
I thought I might do something a club president 
would normally do.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Using the game's high approval, I negotiated with 
the teachers. They might increase our club funding 
from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Really!
Makabe grabbed onto his hands and hopped in joy.

To be honest, even I was doing a triumphant "guts 
pose" in my mind. I'm happy the thing we made 
was well-received...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It seems this was a big success. Good for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Y-Yeah...! Thanks to everyone! Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Now then, our hardship was rewarded... Now that 
it's over, I've gotten rather sleepy...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Whoa now, it's a bit early to rest. Let's celebrate 
with a party? I'm hungry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
That sounds nice, I'll go buy some stuff. I wonder if 
the food stands are still open?

Thus, the cultural festival ended, and the modest 
party in the club room ended as well.

Not too long afterward, only Sena and I remained, 
cleaning up after the party.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...So you haven't slept for three days, right? Leave 
the rest of the cleaning to me; you can go home 
and rest up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm fine, I don't mind cleaning up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That and, I'm so excited I can't calm myself down... 
It would be a waste if I just went home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, I know that feeling. When I went to Comiket, I 
felt the same way.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yeah. After an event like this, the fun, the pain, the 
feeling of accomplishment... all these various feelings 
mixed together, I can't express it in words.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

I kept up this casual conversation, but my heart's 
pounding like crazy.

That's because... I could feel a sense of 
determination coming from Sena's behavior.
With only time passing, the cleaning's almost done...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Um... Senpai.
